Message.MsgText: Rolling IdML Function Component accepts only a SyncWeave Entry as input.

Explanation.p: At the beginning of the Function Component's execution cycle the input data passed was not a SyncWeave Entry.

OperatorResponse.p: Rolling IdML Function Component expects only a SyncWeave Entry as input. Check the AL logic and try again.

Message.MsgText: Rolling IdML Function Component can be used only for IdML books stored as files (in-memory books are not allowed).

Explanation.p: This Function Component is used to roll the generated IdML file when a certain condition is met. Therefore, it is not applicable for in-memory IdML books.

OperatorResponse.p: Either remove (disable) the Rolling IdML Function Component causing the problem, or change the type of the used IdML book to one stored as file (from the Open IdML Function Component).

Message.MsgText: The book 'book name' does not exist or is already closed.
The parameter param name was initialized with the value: 'value'.
Rolling IdML Function Component will work with book: 'book name'.
The name of the currently used book 'book name' has been overridden to 'new name'.

Explanation.p: The specified parameter is needed by the Rolling IdML Function Component and must be provided.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a value for this parameter.
